text:
laura_finance: FYI BrightLabs filed a dispute — Feb invoice shows a ~$18k spike. They say it looks like streaming tokens were counted twice. I pasted their message below.
jen_support: customer says: 'we saw 2.3M tokens on 2026-02-15 for the /v1/streams endpoint, this is 10x our normal day.' they're asking for an immediate credit while you investigate.
laura_finance: @marc_runtime can you check if any streaming metering changes or deploys hit around 2026-02-15?
marc_runtime: I saw an alert around 2026-02-15 03:12 UTC from the runtime test harness. We had a small deploy that touched streaming ACK persistence. Possible race where disconnects -> buffer flush -> re-emit.
marc_runtime: quick log snippet:
```
[2026-02-15T03:12:40Z] request_id=rcv_7Gk stream_init session=se-992
[2026-02-15T03:12:41Z] request_id=rcv_7Gk token_emit count=1421 ack_pending
[2026-02-15T03:12:43Z] session_disconnect session=se-992 reason=timeout
[2026-02-15T03:12:44Z] session_reconnect session=se-992 resync=full token_emit count=1421
```
marc_runtime: that sequence would cause the same token window to be emitted twice unless the metering service de-duplicated by idempotency token. It looks like the persistence key changed during the deploy.
nikhil_sre: We rolled back that deploy at 03:14 UTC after seeing test failures. Correlation is plausible. I'll pull internal deploy tags and infra logs.
olga_prodops: Is this isolated to BrightLabs (one customer) or potentially many? We need to know scope before committing credits.
jen_support: So far BrightLabs is the only report. I pinged other CS reps to check if they've seen noise.
laura_finance: If it's isolated, we can do a targeted credit. If broad, likely a billing backfill and broader customer comms.
marc_runtime: Suggested remediation: run a dedupe backfill using the streaming idempotency token (stream_event.id and sequence numbers). Example query I plan to run in readonly mode first:
```
-- find duplicated token windows
SELECT request_id, account_id, event_seq, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM metering.stream_events
WHERE emitted_at BETWEEN '2026-02-15'::date AND '2026-02-16'::date
GROUP BY request_id, account_id, event_seq
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
marc_runtime: If matches look correct, we can compute the duplicate token total per account and then write a small correction table that billing can consume. Est: discovery 1-2hrs, backfill script 2-3hrs, safe write ~1hr maintenance window.
laura_finance: @olga_prodops any SLA or playbook for targeted credits?
olga_prodops: Finance policy: threshold for auto-credit is >$5k and isolated incidents — provision credit while we run verification. Need a PO/approval from ops lead and a ticket in billing tracker.
jen_support: I've asked BrightLabs to share a few request_ids from their logs for cross-reference. :leftwards_arrow_with_hook:
billing-bot: Created chargeback ticket CB-3271 for BrightLabs dispute (linked to invoice INV-2026-02-18-BL).
nikhil_sre: I pulled the deploy metadata: commit sha 7a4f2b3 touched stream_persist key format. Rolling back removed a format change that would alter the dedupe key. So duplicates are expected for a 2-minute window.
marc_runtime: Confirmed duplicates concentrated between 03:12:40Z and 03:14:00Z. Preliminary dup tokens for BrightLabs ~1.9M tokens. I'll push a readonly result and then a safe correction set to a staging billing table.
laura_finance: Ok. Approving provisional credit up to $20k pending verification. Will tag finance approver later. Please make the correction auditable.
olga_prodops: I'll own comms once you confirm scope. Also add a postmortem entry.
jen_support: BrightLabs responded with three request_ids and said they'd accept a provisional credit while you verify.
marc_runtime: Working on readonly queries now. Will post results in ~45m.
laura_finance: Thanks — keep this thread updated.
jen_support: :thumbsup:
marc_runtime: Result (readonly): found 18 duplicated request windows for BrightLabs total duplicate_tokens=1,910,432. Will generate correction table next.
laura_finance: Good to see numbers. Proceed with correction plan and please include the exact token->USD calc for audit.
nikhil_sre: I'll schedule a brief postmortem with infra and runtime tomorrow.
billing-bot: Provisional credit issued: CR-8952 amount=$18,250 status=pending-verification.
olga_prodops: Assigning owners: marc_runtime -> remediation & script, jen_support -> customer comms, laura_finance -> credit approval signoff, nikhil_sre -> postmortem.
laura_finance: Closing loop: once correction table is written, billing will ingest and adjust invoice; finance to confirm final credit or invoice revision.
jen_support: I'll confirm with BrightLabs when correction completes.
marc_runtime: Starting backfill in 10 minutes (will use maintenance lock to prevent concurrent writes). ETA 3 hours including verification.
laura_finance: Thanks team.
